| id | mode | FIT A | FIT B | effect | class | detection today |
|---|---|---:|---:|---|---|---|
| U1 | VR out of specification, high (half of TI's 40 %) | 0.8 | 0.6 | OCP and OVP thresholds rise together (both scale with REF); no companion announces; > +0.20 % breaks the 288.02 V OVP rule, > +1.1 % passes the 118.74 A R5 pulse row, > +2.6 % passes the 295 V D3 stand-off | fail-dangerous (magnitude unknown) | none |
| U2 | VR out of specification, low | 0.8 | 0.6 | OCP and OVP thresholds fall: more protective; nuisance trip only if large (OVP trips below the ~170 V bus at -39 %, OCP below the 59 A envelope peak at -36 %) | fail-safe | announced only if large |
| U3 | dynamic impedance outside specification (TI 20 %); includes any oscillation | 0.8 | 0.6 | VR moves with U5 current (0.11-0.48 mA window): static error of either sign, magnitude unknown; an AC component on REF25 reaches OCP_THRESH / OVP_THRESH through 6.1 k || 1 nF and 9.3 k || 1 nF (and OCP_NODE through 5 k || 100 pF), so ripple on the threshold side is a nuisance-trip risk, not a mask | half fail-dangerous (k_o) | none |
| U4 | minimum regulation current above specification (TI 40 %) | 1.6 | 1.2 | if IRMIN rises above the 0.11-0.15 mA available, U5 leaves regulation below VR: thresholds fall | fail-safe | announced only if large |
| U5o | cathode pin open (TI: 'device is unpowered') | 0.0 | 0.1667 | REF25 rises to the R31 / load divider: 3.0467-3.3516 V; OVP nominal 341-375 V (band 334-383 V) against the 288.02 V rule; OCP nominal 113-124 A (band top 156 A) against the 117.45 A corner | fail-dangerous | none (FW VBUS over-range latch at 231 V is a diverse OVP layer, not a detection) |
| U6o | anode pin open (TI: 'does not regulate and is held low') | 0.0 | 0.1667 | no DC path through U5 with the anode open: REF25 rises exactly as U5o. TI's 'held low' does not apply to this circuit (its pin FMA assumes 2.2 k feed, SNOAA49A p.5); taken as U5o | fail-dangerous | none |
| U7o | pin 3 (NC) open | 0.0 | 0.1667 | no effect (pin 3 floats by design, SNOS455H p.15) | no effect | - |
| U8s | cathode-anode short (and die short to anode) | 0.0 | 0.1667 | REF25 = 0: OVP_THRESH 0 < VSENSE_IN (bus/120) -> OVP trips at once; OCP node / threshold both 0 -> trips at any bus current above 2 x VOS / 1 mOhm | fail-safe | announced at power-up (BUS_FAULT) |
| U9s | anode-NC short | 0.0 | 0.1667 | no effect (TI class D) | no effect | - |
| U10s | NC-cathode short (TI: 'Iq can increase', class C) | 0.0 | 0.1667 | extra current through the pin-2/pin-3 parasitic Schottky; either REF25 unchanged or clamped low | fail-safe | announced if REF25 clamps |

S-O-D: U1 5-3-9 135; U2 3-3-5 45; U3 5-3-9 135; U4 3-3-5 45; U5o 7-2-9 126; U6o 7-2-9 126; U8s 3-2-1 6; U10s 3-2-5 30

Stability: stable: TI states stability with any capacitive load (SNOS455H p.1), internal compensation with no output capacitor (7.3 p.14) and stability with a bypass capacitor (8.1 p.15). The frozen netlist puts no capacitor on REF25 at all (R31, U5.1, R32, R34, R36 only); the three filter caps sit behind >= 10 k (C30 100 pF via R32, C31 1 nF via R34 12.6 k, C33 1 nF via R36 10 k), so the cathode sees at most pad / trace parasitics directly. Load-capacitance range at the node: ~0 pF direct, 2.1 nF total behind 10-12.6 k. Oscillation is not a credible mode; it is carried inside TI's 20 % 'dynamic impedance' mode (U3).
